name: Positive-operation direction qualifier
summary: A positive-operation qualifier identifies the documented mechanically imposed operating direction.
description: A positive-operation qualifier identifies the documented mechanically imposed operating direction. The useful question is how movement is transmitted to the operated element. A control drawing can distinguish an imposed mechanical action from the device merely following a change in coil supply or a return spring.
Keep the actuator relationship visible when the contact is drawn elsewhere. Position feedback, electrical state and mechanical operating action belong to different parts of the documentation.
readingNotes: Read it together with the associated contact or mechanism and its operating-state legend.
Direction of operation does not specify a complete contact sequence or safety performance.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Read it together with the associated contact or mechanism and its operating-state legend.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
